plugin.name: MaaEnd Executor
plugin.description: Bridges the local MaaEnd executor (Arknights: Endfield automation) so neko-chan can run tasks and narrate progress.
ui.title: MaaEnd executor
ui.disconnectedHint: The control panel backend is not running. Start it by double-clicking .workbuddy\start_panel.bat in the MaaEnd repository.
ui.badResolutionHint: The resolution is not 16:9, and the executor stops the task outright at any other ratio. Set the game to 16:9 first.
ui.notAdmin: The executor is not running as administrator, so the keystrokes it sends to the game go nowhere and the task is guaranteed to fail. Restart the panel with start_panel.bat.
ui.optionsHint: Only change what you need to; anything left alone uses the executor's own default.
ui.noOptions: This task has nothing to configure.
ui.unsupportedOption: This plugin does not know the option type {type}, so it was not rendered.
ui.stopHint: "Stop task" only stops what the executor is running; once stopped, its outcome is no longer announced.
ui.prepareHint: The executor initialises itself on the first run (about 3-5 seconds). "Initialise" is only a manual entry point — the game must already be open.
